description: Converts an ordered list of IPageBlock objects into a Markdown string. Inline HTML in block content (bold, italic, code, links…) is mapped back to CommonMark / GFM syntax. A BlockType.Table block is rendered together with its child TableRow blocks: the separator row reproduces TableBlockContent.ColumnAlignments (:---, :---:, ---:), short rows are padded to the column count, and pipes inside cells are escaped. Legacy pages that stored consecutive TableRow blocks without a parent Table block are still exported correctly.

members.name: HtmlToMarkdownInline
members.description: Converts simple inline HTML (as stored in block content) to CommonMark Markdown.

examples.title: Export page blocks to Markdown
examples.code:
var blocks   = await BlockProvider.GetBlocksAsync(pageId.ToString());
var markdown = NotionMarkdownExporter.Export(blocks, pageTitle: page.Title);
